62/* 'interface' might be defined as a macro on Windows, so we need to
63 * undefine it so as not to break the current libusb API, because
64 * libusb_config_descriptor has an 'interface' member
65 * As this can be problematic if you include windows.h after libusb.h
66 * in your sources, we force windows.h to be included first. */
67#if defined(_WIN32) || defined(__CYGWIN__)
68#include <windows.h>
69#if defined(interface)
70#undef interface
71#endif
72#endif /* _WIN32 || __CYGWIN__ */

77#define LIBUSB_DEPRECATED_FOR(f) __attribute__ ((deprecated ("Use " #f " instead")))

117/* LIBUSB_CALL must be defined on both definition and declaration of libusb
118 * functions. You'd think that declaration would be enough, but cygwin will
119 * complain about conflicting types unless both are marked this way.
120 * The placement of this macro is important too; it must appear after the
121 * return type, before the function name. See internal documentation for
122 * API_EXPORTED.
123 */
124#if defined(_WIN32) || defined(__CYGWIN__)
125#define LIBUSB_CALL WINAPI
126#define LIBUSB_CALLV WINAPIV
127#else
128#define LIBUSB_CALL
129#define LIBUSB_CALLV
130#endif /* _WIN32 || __CYGWIN__ */

200static inline uint16_t libusb_cpu_to_le16(uint16_t x)
201{
202 union {
203 uint8_t b8[2];
204 uint16_t b16;
205 } _tmp;
206 _tmp.b8[1] = (uint8_t) (x >> 8);
207 _tmp.b8[0] = (uint8_t) (x & 0xff);
208 return _tmp.b16;
209}

1998static inline void libusb_fill_control_transfer(
1999 struct libusb_transfer *transfer, libusb_device_handle *dev_handle,
2000 unsigned char *buffer, libusb_transfer_cb_fn callback, void *user_data,
2001 unsigned int timeout)
2002{
2003 struct libusb_control_setup *setup = (struct libusb_control_setup *)(void *)buffer;
2004 transfer->dev_handle = dev_handle;
2005 transfer->endpoint = 0;
2006 transfer->type = LIBUSB_TRANSFER_TYPE_CONTROL;
2007 transfer->timeout = timeout;
2008 if (setup)
2009 {
2010 int length = (int) (LIBUSB_CONTROL_SETUP_SIZE
2011 + libusb_le16_to_cpu(setup->wLength));
2012 transfer->buffer = buffer;
2013 transfer->length = length;
2014 }
2015 else
2016 {
2017 transfer->buffer = NULL;
2018 transfer->length = 0;
2019 }
2020 transfer->user_data = user_data;
2021 transfer->callback = callback;
2022}

2171static inline unsigned char *libusb_get_iso_packet_buffer(
2172 struct libusb_transfer *transfer, unsigned int packet)
2173{
2174 int i;
2175 size_t offset = 0;
2176 int _packet;
2177
2178 /* oops..slight bug in the API. packet is an unsigned int, but we use
2179 * signed integers almost everywhere else. range-check and convert to
2180 * signed to avoid compiler warnings. FIXME for libusb-2. */
2181 if (packet > INT_MAX)
2182 return NULL;
2183 _packet = (int) packet;
2184
2185 if (_packet >= transfer->num_iso_packets)
2186 return NULL;
2187
2188 for (i = 0; i < _packet; i++)
2189 offset += transfer->iso_packet_desc[i].length;
2190
2191 return transfer->buffer + offset;
2192}

2213static inline unsigned char *libusb_get_iso_packet_buffer_simple(
2214 struct libusb_transfer *transfer, unsigned int packet)
2215{
2216 int _packet;
2217
2218 /* oops..slight bug in the API. packet is an unsigned int, but we use
2219 * signed integers almost everywhere else. range-check and convert to
2220 * signed to avoid compiler warnings. FIXME for libusb-2. */
2221 if (packet > INT_MAX)
2222 return NULL;
2223 _packet = (int) packet;
2224
2225 if (_packet >= transfer->num_iso_packets)
2226 return NULL;
2227
2228 return transfer->buffer + ((int) transfer->iso_packet_desc[0].length * _packet);
2229}
